data.long_meaning: In Greek, Jewell means 'jewel' or 'precious stone'. It is a beautiful and meaningful name for a girl, evoking images of beauty, value, and rarity. In the Bible, jewels are often used as symbols of spiritual and eternal value, making this name a perfect choice for a Christian girl. The name Jewell carries the meaning “Jewel, precious stone” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Jewell usually hope their child will grow to embody jewel, precious stone and live with faith, good character and purpose.
